tickets.goal: In octopus/businesses.py, introduce one small private helper named _display_name that returns business.name when a declared business object is present and otherwise returns the business_id. Use it only in overview() where the output row currently selects between business.name and business_id. Preserve discovery behavior, cache behavior, handler ordering, budget semantics, overview ordering, rendered text, database queries, and every public API. Do not modify tests or any other file.
acceptance_criteria: _display_name returns business.name for a declared business and business_id otherwise
overview uses the helper only for the existing row name selection
discovery, cache invalidation, handler ordering, budgets, overview ordering, and rendered output remain unchanged
no database query, import, public API, or module-level side effect changes
the businesses oracle passes with the same PASSED node set as the baseline
